Useful for syslog-ng / fluent-bit HTTP output plugins.

get.description:
SSE stream of job phase updates (not LLM tokens).

Polls Mongo until status is terminal (done / failed / error) or timeout.
Useful for upload UI progress without tight client polling loops.

post.description:
Re-queue a failed or hung pipeline job when the durable payload still exists.

Worker picks it up on the next poll (same process or after restart). Use when
upload shows stuck mid-phase or failed with a recoverable error.
Single-file upload — durable queue (A-S7) with BackgroundTasks fallback kick.

Multi-file / ZIP incident-package upload (durable queue A-S7).

- Accepts up to 20 files (or a single .zip containing many)
- Auto-detects each file's format (Apache / Syslog / JSON / CSV / CEF / LEEF / plain)
- Correlates events across all files into a single incident
Atomic HiTL action — only one reviewer wins if concurrent requests race.

get.description: List product roadmap items (seeded from weekly discussions).

post.description:
Seed roadmap from weekly discussions.

force=true upserts seed items by id.
By default preserves owner + local progress/status/tasks/notes.
reset_progress=true applies seed status/progress/tasks/implementation_notes
(still preserves owner and created_at).

parameters.description: With force=true, overwrite status/progress/tasks/notes from seed (does not keep stale in-DB progress). Use after shipping a seed item as completed.
parameters.name: reset_progress

schema.description: With force=true, overwrite status/progress/tasks/notes from seed (does not keep stale in-DB progress). Use after shipping a seed item as completed.
schema.title: Reset Progress

post.description: Convert a roadmap item into a starter set of development tasks (if empty or force fill gaps).
Add an actionable development task under a roadmap item.
Alias for PUT /settings (some proxies mishandle PUT).

put.description:
Save Admin → Settings. Blank secret fields keep existing keys; use
clear_fields / __CLEAR__ / POST /settings/clear-secrets to wipe.

post.description:
Apply factory or recommended ops profile (keeps API keys / Slack by default).

Persists immediately — no separate Save required.

Clear configured secrets so enrichment falls back to mock / keys must be re-entered.

scope:
  - threat_intel: AbuseIPDB, VirusTotal, GreyNoise, ThreatFox, OTX, Shodan, Cohere
  - llm: Anthropic / OpenAI / Gemini / Groq
  - notifications: Slack webhook
  - all: every secret field
  - custom: body.fields list of Settings field names

get.description: List locally recorded alert emails (always written, even without SMTP).
Email transport readiness (SMTP optional) + recipient + recent outbox.
Document factory vs recommended ops for tooltips / apply buttons.

post.description: Factory-reset Admin → Settings to Pydantic defaults (not env overrides).

get.description: Slack Incoming Webhook readiness (no OAuth bot install required).

post.description:
Smoke-test email alerts. SMTP is optional — default delivery uses HTTP gateway.

Example:
  POST /api/settings/test-email
  {"to": "sarvesh.sood@gmail.com", "save_recipient": true}

Smoke-test Slack alerts via Incoming Webhook.

Install steps:
  1. https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks — Create Incoming Webhook
  2. Pick a channel → copy the URL (hooks.slack.com/services/T…/B…/…)
  3. Paste in Settings or POST here with save_webhook=true
  4. POST /api/settings/test-slack
